name: ExampleCRM
target_reader: Solo founders and small service businesses (1-10 people) in English-speaking countries who handle customer inquiries themselves
pain_points: Inquiries are split across email and DMs, so it is unclear who has been answered
Forgetting to follow up after sending a quote
Re-reading old email threads to remember what was discussed last time
Explaining the same history again whenever the person in charge changes
notes: サンプル。ASPで提携後、公式規約を自分で確認して各項目を埋め、verified=true にすると自動投稿の対象になる。
